gaps.section: Part II: relative restriction-free de Rham–Witt, extending CR.4
gaps.needs: For every Λ-ring A that is a ℤ_(p)-algebra and every A-algebra R, prove that the absolute restriction-free FV map W_(a+1)Ω_(R/ℤ_(p))→qW_(pᵃ)Ω_(R/A), for all a≥0, kills the differentials of the image of W_(a+1)(A), hence factors through the relative ordinary complex, compatibly with Frobenius and Verschiebung.

gaps.section: Further Part II extension: finite-projective Frobenius/Nygaard transport beyond §§3.13–3.16
gaps.needs: For a finite-projective Λ-map A→B of perfectly covered bases, supply coherent completed scalar-extension equivalences for the actual relative Frobenius and Nygaard filtration of every twisted smooth q-de Rham input of §§3.15 and 3.22, natural in smooth algebras and compatible with divisor maps, products, identity and composition.

gaps.section: Part II: finite-projective filtered décalage transport, extending AI.1
gaps.needs: For the finite-projective Λ-base changes and twisted q-de Rham inputs of §4.26, supply natural scalar-extension equivalences for Lη and its entire décalage filtration, with the displayed regular parameters, completed tensors, coefficient twists and coherence under identity, composition and tensor products.

gaps.section: Part II: unbounded derived commutative algebras, extending E5:animation.4
gaps.needs: For every commutative coefficient ring B, construct the unbounded derived commutative category DAlg_B and a conservative forgetful functor to CAlg(D(B)) creating limits and colimits, naturally under coefficient extension, with the static-ring and cosimplicial-envelope realizations used in §1.18; this is distinct from connective animated rings.

gaps.section: Part II: filtered and graded derived commutative algebras, extending E5:abstract and E5:animation.4
gaps.needs: Supply filtered and graded refinements of the unbounded DAlg_B contract, compatible with Day tensor, associated graded, Rees modules, localization, degree-one filtered quotients, completion, animation and enhanced descent as used in §§3.18, 3.30, 4.23 and 5.22, with conservative forgetful comparisons preserving the required diagrams.

gaps.section: Part II: fully faithful pushouts in Cat∞, extending E0.4–E0.5
gaps.needs: For every pushout C⊔_A B in Cat∞ with A→B fully faithful, prove C→C⊔_A B fully faithful, with the mapping-space comparison natural in the pushout diagram; generic existence of coherent pushouts or stable pushouts does not supply this theorem.

gaps.section: Part II: cyclotomic completion topology, using §4.1 (shared QWittVectors gap)
gaps.needs: Using the distinct-order integral cyclotomic ideal classification already targeted in §4.1, supply only the induced common-completion identifications and prime-to-p product splitting required in §0.2.

gaps.section: Part II: dual fibrations and oplax monoidal functors, extending E5:abstract.1–E5:abstract.3
gaps.needs: For every symmetric monoidal infinity-category, construct its dual cartesian fibration over N(Fin_*) opposite with cocartesian-leg span morphisms; identify oplax symmetric monoidal functors with inert-preserving functors of the dual fibrations and strong monoidality with preservation of all cartesian edges, coherently under identity and composition.
